evals.prompt: Can you set up a readingroom review for PR 128 in ~/Codes/tardis-feature-service-sdk? Keep the narrative short.
evals.expected_output: Runs `readingroom pr 128 --repo … --detach`, reads the diff, writes a review.html with a lede, a clickable rr-flow delta diagram, linked sections and a sign-off checklist; reports the URL.

evals.prompt: I sent my feedback in readingroom, go through the threads and answer them. For the one about the cache, show me what the keys look like.
evals.expected_output: Reads the feedback (threads / status --json), replies to each thread with readingroom reply, adds a data-round section with a key visualisation for the cache question and links/embeds it from the reply, then reruns readingroom review.

evals.prompt: walk me through what https://github.com/sharechat/moj-feed-aggregator-service/pull/412 changes, top-down from the handler
